description: This file defines a plugin entry for the Vercel AI Gateway provider within a plugin-based architecture. It exports a default provider entry that includes provider metadata, authentication configuration, and catalog building functions, facilitating integration of Vercel AI Gateway in the larger system.

methods.name: applyVercelAiGatewayConfig
methods.description: Applies the Vercel AI Gateway configuration to the given configuration object.

methods.name: buildVercelAiGatewayProvider
methods.description: Builds and returns the Vercel AI Gateway provider object.
